title: Outpatient Pharmacy Self-Pay List: Oral Drugs Not Otherwise Classified — Insurance Claim (Third-Party Billing)
content:
**Self-pay price list term.** Oral drugs not otherwise classified (code J8499 under revenue code 0637) on an observation or emergency account of the Hospital Account (Encounter Billing), valued for an Insurance Claim (Third-Party Billing), are valued at their charges times their quantity share on Riverbend's outpatient pharmacy self-pay list, by units dispensed (its billed units):

| Units dispensed | Quantity share |
|---|---|
| 3 or more | 0.45 |
| 2 | 0.6 |
| a single unit | 1 |

Example (hypothetical charges of 50.00): 1 unit → 50.00; 2 units → 30.00; 3 units → 22.50.
